title: OLEANDER Built-Environment Accessibility Professional Process v1.0
purpose: Run bounded professional built-environment accessibility development from jurisdiction, rights and task/context basis through continuous access journey, usable spaces/fixtures/controls, information, safety-system interfaces, coordination, representative testing, delivery/field readback and in-use accommodation/change while preserving digital-accessibility, legal-rights, FLS, technical-domain and R-F authority boundaries.
scope_in: physical built-environment accessibility basis and duties
people, tasks, barriers and accommodation interfaces
accessible space, fixture, equipment and physical control use
doors, lifts, security, controls and emergency-use interfaces
documentation, procurement, site inspection and field readback
in-use accommodation, feedback and accessibility change
scope_out: automatic Digital Accessibility or WCAG conformance
automatic closure of all rights or reasonable-accommodation duties
automatic universal usability for every person/context
automatic R-F Integration PASS, Design KEEP or Project Promotion
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, R-F Cross-Disciplinary Integration, applicable rights/legal authority, project jurisdiction and responsible accessibility/design professionals.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on physical access, continuous accessible use, accessible facilities/controls/information, emergency accessibility, accommodation interaction, representative physical-task testing or field accessibility readback.
responsibility_triggers: an accessibility requirement controls geometry, product or operation
a physical route/use/accommodation claim has project consequence
FLS/security/vertical-transport or other system state affects accessible use
representative task/user testing is needed to close uncertainty
field installation or operational change can invalidate accessibility
jurisdiction/source review status materially changes an applicable claim
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable valid boundary across rights/statutory duty, jurisdiction/source status, appointment, actor/task evidence, exact geometry/product configuration, interface maturity, representative testing, field readback and external professional/authority review governs each accessibility claim.
not_triggered_when: a digital-only accessibility claim is fully owned by the Digital Accessibility professional/knowledge route with no material physical interface
an accessibility precedent is reference-only and no project accessibility claim is made
mandatory_reopen_triggers: jurisdiction, rights duty, standard/source edition or review outcome changes
site level, route, entry, room or furniture/equipment layout changes
door, lift, security, control or service-system changes
failed representative task or field readback
complaint, accommodation or incident evidence contradicts assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential accessibility, rights, physical-standard, user/task, product/system, field and accommodation evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional accessibility decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER Professional Domain Process and Design Quality contracts
source_routes: ISO 21542:2021 as current published international built-environment accessibility edition under systematic review
product/system sources under their existing owners
evidence_routes: mockup/representative task or specialist review evidence
precedent_case_routes: bounded accessibility precedents with explicit jurisdiction, task, user and transfer limits
practice_routes: field accessibility inspection and change control
tool_knowledge_routes: CAD/BIM geometry checks and simulations only as partial evidence under declared source/configuration boundaries

stages.professional_question: What built-environment accessibility claim is in scope, under which rights/statutory/professional route, for which physical environment and users?
entry_conditions: project and accessibility decision scope identified
knowledge_inputs: accessibility index and applicable source routes
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential rights/standard/applicability claims require task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: identify rights, statutory, architecture, FLS and specialist owners
human_experience_consequences: affected people/tasks and known accommodation needs become explicit
design_language_consequences: visual/spatial design intent cannot override accessibility duties
technical_consequences: source status, including standards under review, remains explicit
content_projection_requirements: state jurisdiction, source/version/status, appointment, rights route and claim ceiling
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review required for promotion-relevant adoption.
open_items_allowed: later detailed task/geometry issues may remain open at basis stage
exit_conditions: accessibility authority, source status, scope and claim ceiling are explicit
reopen_triggers: jurisdiction, rights, source-status, scope or use change

stages.professional_question: Who must use or is affected by the environment, to perform what task, under which capability, assistive-device and contextual conditions?
entry_conditions: basis and affected physical scope identified
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Human/user/accommodation evidence remains scope- and source-bound.
interface_requirements: operations, rights and design owners receive relevant task/barrier inputs
human_experience_consequences: mobility, sensory, cognitive, communication and assistance conditions addressed without stereotyping
design_language_consequences: design consistency may yield where task access requires a different solution
technical_consequences: disability label alone cannot substitute for task/context requirement
content_projection_requirements: barrier/requirement claims preserve evidence and limitations
required_readback: actor/task/barrier evidence and missing representation readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for reusable process adoption, not for every project observation by default.
open_items_allowed: unrepresented user contexts remain explicit UNKNOWN rather than generalized
exit_conditions: material accessibility tasks/barriers and evidence gaps are explicit
reopen_triggers: user, task, context or accommodation basis change

stages.professional_question: Is the required physical journey continuous from approach through destination/use and exit/emergency interfaces rather than a set of isolated passing fragments?
entry_conditions: material users/tasks and project access scope defined
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Technical requirements and source values require applicable current source mounts.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Landscape, Structure, MEP, Vertical Transportation, Security and FLS coordination
human_experience_consequences: whole journey, assistance and return/exit conditions remain legible and usable
design_language_consequences: threshold, level and route legibility consequences remain visible
technical_consequences: one passing segment cannot support a continuous-route claim
content_projection_requirements: critical level/door/lift/threshold pinch points are explicitly shown
required_readback: continuous-route topology and critical pinch readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for candidate process adoption; project statutory review remains separate.
open_items_allowed: later detailed field verification may remain open when claim stays at coordinated-design level
exit_conditions: no unresolved in-claim critical break exists in the required continuous journey
reopen_triggers: site level, route, entry, door, lift, room location or FLS route change

stages.stage_name: Space / Fixture / Equipment / Physical Control Use
stages.professional_question: Can the declared task be performed with appropriate approach, manoeuvre, transfer, reach, operation, privacy, dignity and assistance at the destination?
entry_conditions: destination/task scope and applicable journey resolved
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Dimensions/product-operation claims require applicable current sources and exact product evidence.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Interior, MEP, FF&E/Product, Structure and Operations coordination
human_experience_consequences: independence, assistance, privacy/dignity and real task sequence addressed
design_language_consequences: finish/furniture language cannot consume required operable/clear space
content_projection_requirements: approach/transfer/reach/operation conditions are graphical and traceable
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review remains separate from project product/system approvals.
open_items_allowed: representative task/field tests may remain later if uncertainty is explicitly tracked
exit_conditions: material task-use geometry/interfaces are coordinated at the declared claim ceiling
reopen_triggers: room, furniture, fixture, equipment, control or assistance condition change

stages.professional_question: Can people identify, understand and act on the built-environment information needed to navigate and use the place?
entry_conditions: journey, decision points and communication tasks identified
interface_requirements: Wayfinding/Graphic, Lighting, Acoustics, Architecture and Digital Accessibility where physically coupled
human_experience_consequences: visual, tactile, auditory and cognitive information needs addressed as applicable
design_language_consequences: brand/visual consistency cannot defeat legibility or task meaning
technical_consequences: digital conformance remains with Digital Accessibility owner
content_projection_requirements: information role, location, medium and task remain explicit
required_readback: decision-point and installed/representative information readback where claimed
stages.independent_review_requirement: Professional process review remains separate from wayfinding/digital-accessibility reviews.
open_items_allowed: later artwork/product implementation may remain open if requirements are fixed and claim bounded
exit_conditions: material physical wayfinding/information requirements and interfaces are coordinated
reopen_triggers: route, lighting, signage, information, language or physical-digital interface change

stages.stage_name: Doors / Lifts / Controls / Safety / Emergency Interfaces
stages.professional_question: Do building systems and controlled elements support accessible use in normal, degraded and emergency states?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: System/product capabilities require exact identity and applicable source evidence.
interface_requirements: FLS, Vertical Transportation, Security, MEP/Electrical, Controls and Architecture coordination
human_experience_consequences: normal, assisted, degraded and emergency use states addressed
design_language_consequences: controls/security integration must preserve discoverability and operability
technical_consequences: system command/certification does not prove actual accessible operation
content_projection_requirements: physical end state and assistance/failure consequences are explicit
stages.independent_review_requirement: Accessibility review does not replace FLS/system technical approval.
open_items_allowed: system commissioning may remain owned by later/other domain when current claim is bounded
exit_conditions: material accessibility system-interface requirements are coordinated

stages.professional_question: Are accessibility requirements preserved across all materially coupled geometry, products, systems, information and operations?
required_inputs: current R-F interface objects and domain outputs
interface_requirements: critical accessibility interfaces must reach maturity required by the current project claim
human_experience_consequences: continuous task/journey consequences are read back across domain boundaries
design_language_consequences: visual/spatial coherence cannot hide an accessibility conflict
technical_consequences: Accessibility coordination does not award R-F or other-domain PASS
content_projection_requirements: critical open interfaces and owners remain visible
required_readback: actual coordinated geometry/product/system state for critical interfaces
stages.independent_review_requirement: Professional review remains separate from R-F Integration review.
open_items_allowed: outside-claim/later work only where it does not contradict current accessibility claim
exit_conditions: no unresolved in-claim critical accessibility contradiction remains at required interface maturity

stages.professional_question: Where material uncertainty remains, does representative physical task/testing evidence support the bounded accessibility claim?
interface_requirements: test findings route to affected design/system/rights owners
human_experience_consequences: failed tasks and subgroup/high-consequence issues cannot be averaged away
design_language_consequences: tested usability may require design-language exception
technical_consequences: designer simulation does not substitute for representative disabled-person evidence where required
required_readback: actual task outcome, failure and limitation readback
stages.professional_review_owner: Built-Environment Accessibility professional/specialist or applicable human-factors/test owner
stages.independent_review_requirement: Test evidence review remains separate from candidate-process Independent Review.
open_items_allowed: unrepresented contexts remain UNKNOWN and must not be generalized
exit_conditions: tested claim is bounded to exact representative evidence and unresolved failures are routed
reopen_triggers: configuration, task, population/context or acceptance criterion change

stages.professional_question: Has accessibility intent survived detailed documentation, product selection, substitution, installation and actual field conditions?
entry_conditions: accessibility design scope sufficiently resolved for delivery
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Product/submittal/field evidence must be current and exact-scope mounted evidence.
interface_requirements: substitution/site changes propagate to affected owners and R-F interfaces
human_experience_consequences: actual route/task/control/information conditions checked where claimed
design_language_consequences: finishes/furniture/temporary elements cannot silently consume access
technical_consequences: field dimensions/operation are distinguished from drawing intent
stages.professional_review_owner: Built-Environment Accessibility professional/specialist owner plus applicable authority owners
stages.independent_review_requirement: Candidate process Independent Review remains separate from project statutory/site acceptance.
open_items_allowed: outside-claim authority/accommodation items with explicitly capped claim
exit_conditions: declared delivery scope has current field/readback evidence and no hidden critical nonconformity
reopen_triggers: substitution, field deviation, furnishing, operational or failed-inspection change

stages.professional_question: Does the environment remain accessible through operation, furnishing, maintenance, changing users/tasks and accommodation needs?
entry_conditions: environment is in use or transition to use
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Operational observations remain project/context-scoped unless separately validated for reuse.
interface_requirements: Operations/FM, rights owner and affected design/system owners receive material changes
human_experience_consequences: real barriers, support burden and accommodation experience remain visible
design_language_consequences: operational presentation/temporary fitout cannot block accessible use
technical_consequences: in-use contradiction can reopen drawing/system/product accessibility claims
content_projection_requirements: complaint/accommodation evidence preserves privacy, uncertainty and transfer boundary
stages.professional_review_owner: Built-Environment Accessibility / rights / operations owner as applicable
stages.independent_review_requirement: Reusable learning remains subject to Knowledge validation; candidate process adoption remains independently reviewed.
open_items_allowed: non-material observations may remain monitored without widening claims
exit_conditions: material in-use accessibility changes are routed and affected prior claims reopened or confirmed
reopen_triggers: accommodation request, complaint, recurring barrier, operational change, incident or source update

controlling_authority_requirements: rights/legal/statutory authority is not replaced by R-E
FLS and other system/domain technical authority remains separate
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Accessibility may define professional interface requirements but R-F owns IDENTIFIED/DEFINED/COORDINATED/EXERCISED/VERIFIED maturity and OPEN/BLOCKED/CLOSED/OUTSIDE_CLAIM disposition.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: later/outside-claim work may remain open only when current accessibility claim is not widened and no critical continuous-journey/task contradiction remains
integration_readback_requirements: actual geometry/product/system state for critical accessibility interfaces
continuous task/journey readback and change propagation

native_source_of_truth_rules: editable drawings/models/schedules remain source authority within professional scope
automated geometry check or simulation cannot replace field/representative task evidence
execution_owner_requirements: separate digital accessibility, FLS and technical-domain owners
required_capabilities: continuous journey and task-use design review
tool_adapter_requirements: tools preserve units, source/version, geometry/product/configuration and evidence provenance
no automated checker or simulation may self-award professional/statutory PASS
typed_handoff_contracts: operational observations to bounded G9 candidate route
actual_readback_requirements: verify exact route/task/product/control state before field/usability claims

assurance.professional_review: Built-Environment Accessibility professional/specialist review of exact current scope and native outputs.
assurance.evidence_review: Evidence/Truth review remains separate for source applicability, human/task, product and field claims.
assurance.independent_review: Promotion-relevant adoption of this reusable process requires exact-input eligible Independent Professional Domain review under Current review-freshness controls.
assurance.receipt_contract: A professional receipt must bind project/task scope, exact process/stage revision, jurisdiction/source/right basis, native outputs/readback, open items, reviewer/owner and claim ceiling.

stale_scope_rules: mark only accessibility claims depending on materially changed inputs/interfaces stale
historical receipts remain immutable under their consumed source/configuration snapshot
upstream_impact_rules: rights/source/user/task changes may reopen basis/context and dependent journey/use stages
downstream_impact_rules: journey/use/system changes propagate to coordination, testing, delivery and in-use requirements
interface_reopen_rules: reopen affected R-F interfaces when shared geometry/product/system/operational variables materially change
receipt_stale_rules: a receipt cannot support a materially changed route/task/product/source relation without scoped re-resolution and new evidence

process_exit_conditions: applicable accessibility stages executed for declared physical scope
critical continuous-journey/task contradictions resolved at required claim ceiling
required native readback and triggered reviews exist
open_items_allowed: outside-claim or later rights/statutory/accommodation items when explicitly bounded and non-contradictory
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Exact-scope Built-Environment Accessibility professional receipt with rights/jurisdiction/source basis, task/configuration, readback, review and claim ceiling.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Professional Process PASS cannot directly promote Project, Design Quality, Integration, Knowledge, rights or statutory state; those remain owner-controlled.

execution_depth_contract.parity_rule: Equivalent Built-Environment Accessibility execution depth is demonstrated through rights/jurisdiction basis, continuous journey, task-use, sensory/information, system-state, representative testing, field and in-use accommodation objects rather than dimension-check completeness.
professional_problem_and_judgment_object: Space / Fixture / Equipment / Control Task-Use Register
implementation_field_objects: field dimensions/levels/clearances and operational obstruction readback
installed fixture/control/door/lift task test where in claim
handover_inuse_objects: temporary obstruction/service outage and recovery record
independent_review_objects: independent accessibility professional review at claim ceiling
rights/legal and statutory review remain separate
representative user evidence is distinct from professional review
change_propagation_objects: field failure/accommodation request → exact affected scope and retest
does_not_require: minimum technical compliance as universal usability
representative user test where claim does not reach that ceiling
